data.body_html:
Planning a group trip to Marbella? Understanding the Puerto Banús yacht charter cost per person in 2028 is key to budgeting. We break down exact prices for our fleet, so you know what you'll pay—no surprises. Whether you're 5 or 12 people, you can split the total charter fee evenly. Our Tier A boats start at just €83 per person for a 2-hour cruise, while luxury options like the Mangusta 80 include a free jet ski. Read on for the full breakdown.

How the per-person cost works

All our charters are priced per boat, not per person. You and your group split the total. For example, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) costs €749 for 2 hours. With 9 guests, that’s €83 each. For an 8-hour day, it’s €2,299, or about €255 per person. The same logic applies to every boat. No hidden fees—the quoted price includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT.

2028 pricing for Tier A boats

Our Tier A boats are the most affordable for small to medium groups.

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax): €749/2h → €2,299/8h
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax): €749/2h → €2,299/8h

Per person (based on max capacity):

  • 2 hours: €68–€83/person
  • 4 hours: ~€153/person (estimated from 8h rate)
  • 8 hours: €209–€255/person

Both depart from Puerto Banús and include all standard inclusions.

2028 pricing for Tier B boats

For a premium experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) and its grey variant are available from €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter. This includes a free jet ski. Per person with 12 guests: about €393 for 4 hours. Perfect for a half-day luxury escape along the Marbella coastline.

Other boats and custom quotes

For boats like the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax), or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), pricing is on request. Contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. These vessels offer more space, higher speeds, and additional amenities. Per-person costs vary based on group size and charter duration.

Every charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extra charges for ice, cups, or crew. Just show up at Puerto Banús with your group and enjoy.

Tips to lower your per-person cost

  • Max out the boat's capacity: a 12-pax boat split 12 ways is cheaper than 10.
  • Book longer charters: the hourly rate drops from €375 to €287 on Tier A boats.
  • Choose a weekday: availability is better, though pricing is the same.
  • Bring your own food: you're welcome to bring additional snacks or a picnic.

Why Puerto Banús is perfect for group charters

Puerto Banús is the epicentre of Marbella's luxury boating scene. Depart from its marina, cruise past the Golden Mile, anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, and enjoy views of La Concha mountain. The water is warm (22–26°C in summer), and the coastline offers numerous spots for swimming and sunbathing. Our boats depart exclusively from Puerto Banús, making logistics simple.
